The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying a uniform dark brown color with faint lighter edges and subtle eye-spots. It rests on a cluster of small purple florets surrounded by bright green leaves. The background is a soft-focus green bokeh.

The connection point of the antennae to the head is vague. The antennae themselves lack the rigid, jointed structure and clubbed tips, appearing as soft, floating curves.
Some purple florets directly beneath the butterfly's legs seem to merge slightly with the insect's feet, indicating minor boundary bleeding or depth confusion.
The edges of the wings are slightly too soft compared to the sharpness of the nearby flower petals, suggesting a generation artifact rather than optical depth-of-field blur.
